name: 4 Person Far Infrared Sauna (GSE-4)
description:
Experience therapeutic results in our 4-person sauna
Our spacious GHS large sauna is one of the most effective infrared saunas on the market. GHS certified heaters deliver the highest quality far infrared heat while producing virtually no EMF. Made from Forest Stewardship Certified Wood and certified tempered glass, this 4-person sauna uses infrared technology to relieve stress, expel toxins and improve your overall health.
